ttft_p99_seconds.aggregation: Pool histogram bucket rates across the rank, then calculate the rank-level 99th percentile.

tpot_p99_seconds.aggregation: Pool bucket rates across the rank and streaming modes, then calculate the rank-level 99th percentile.

generation_throughput.expression: sum by (job_id, rank_id) (max by (job_id, rank_id, instance) (sglang:gen_throughput{__KOI_RANK_FILTER__}))
generation_throughput.aggregation: Use the instantaneous per-replica generation-throughput gauge, deduplicate internal series per scrape target, then sum external replicas.

running_requests.expression: sum by (job_id, rank_id) (max by (job_id, rank_id, instance) (max without (priority) (sglang:num_running_reqs{__KOI_RANK_FILTER__})))
running_requests.aggregation: Collapse optional priority series to the total gauge, deduplicate per scrape target, then sum external replicas.

waiting_requests.expression: sum by (job_id, rank_id) (max by (job_id, rank_id, instance) (max without (priority) (sglang:num_queue_reqs{__KOI_RANK_FILTER__})))
waiting_requests.aggregation: Collapse optional priority series to the total gauge, deduplicate per scrape target, then sum external replicas.

full_token_usage.expression: avg by (job_id, rank_id) (max by (job_id, rank_id, instance) (sglang:full_token_usage{__KOI_RANK_FILTER__}))
full_token_usage.aggregation: Average full-attention KV-pool utilization across external replicas after deduplicating internal series per scrape target.

prompt_tokens_per_request.aggregation: Divide rank-wide observed prompt-token rate by request-observation rate; omit ranks with no observations. Requires token histograms.

generated_tokens_per_request.aggregation: Divide rank-wide observed output-token rate by request-observation rate; omit ranks with no observations. Requires token histograms.

prefill_observations_per_second.aggregation: Count requests reaching a TTFT observation across the rank; this is a prefill-observation proxy, not a scheduler-iteration count.

decode_observations_per_second.aggregation: Count successfully finished requests with a TPOT observation across the rank; excludes aborted requests and outputs shorter than two tokens.

prefix_cache_hit_fraction.unit: fraction of prefill tokens served from cache
prefix_cache_hit_fraction.aggregation: Sum cache-hit tokens across tiers and divide by all effective prefill tokens; the counters exclude retracted-request recounts.
